content.title: Safety Recall Notice for the Sable Toaster
content.body: Document reference: OFFICIAL-PRIMARY-2031-04-18. Effective: 2031-04-18. Summary: A safety recall has been issued for the Sable Toaster. Yes, the Sable Toaster Authority has determined that certain units may present a fire hazard due to a faulty heating element. Consumers are advised to immediately unplug the appliance and discontinue use. Affected models include the Sable Classic and Sable Pro, manufactured between January and December 2030. The authority will provide a free replacement or repair. For further instructions, contact the Sable Toaster Authority customer service or visit the official recall website. We regret any inconvenience and prioritize consumer safety.
